arguments.value: Donald L. Graham, born in 1948 in Salisbury, North Carolina, is a United States District Judge for the Southern District of Florida. He earned a B.A. from West Virginia State College in 1971 and a J.D. from the Ohio State University College of Law in 1974. His career included service as a U.S. Army major in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps from 1974 to 1979, an adjunct instructor at the University of Maryland from 1975 to 1977, assistant U.S. attorney for the Southern District of Florida from 1979 to 1984, service in the U.S. Army Reserve JAG Corps from 1983 to 1991, and private practice in Miami from 1984 to 1991. He was nominated to the federal bench in 1991 and later assumed senior status in 2013.
